items.summary: If you store PHI on Supabase, you need a signed BAA and a project set to High Compliance. That takes care of the platform. It doesn't cover your RLS policies, your functions or your audit tables, and a HIPAA review will ask about those too. Supabase's shared responsibility model says the same. It tells you to "always apply Row Level Security (RLS)" and leaves the access rules on sensitive tables to you. The part Supabase handles On the hosted platform, Supabase encrypts data at rest and in transit, signs the BAA and checks your project settings. Its HIPAA guide asks you to turn on Point in Time Recovery, SSL enforcement, network restrictions…
items.title: Munaf Khatri: Supabase is one part of your HIPAA compliance
